cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brief me on tomorrow's hike. Route first, then meeting point; muddled instructions are how people get lost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're taking the ridge because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've given the reason. Now give the exact meeting point, so nobody has to wander about looking for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told you twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I am testing your briefing, not asking for directions. Begin with the meeting point this time. I'll stop you when you've supplied enough detail.
